notes.title: New game: Smile to Fly is out!
notes.content:
Hello! Today I would like to tell you about my new game - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1164330/Smile_To_Fly/]Smile To Fly[/url], which is released today!
Smile To Fly is a strategy/simulator tower defence game, where you need to build and develop your own space colony! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33229994/6319f65e2b061cac56272b1090c97b5a531779d4.gif[/img]

Mine gold and electricity, find new inhabitants in space, and eventually make them happy - because the energy of happiness through smile-to-fly technology can be transformed into rocket fuel. Use your own rocket to discover new planets and find new colonists!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33229994/4f66acca58bcd5c09c03d794614c016cb60abbd6.gif[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1164330/Smile_To_Fly/]Check it out here![/url]
Thank you and have a nice day :)

notes.title: Neverliria Major Update!
notes.content:
Hello! After a long pause I'm finally glad to announce that [b]Neverliria[/b] is majorly updated! You can find a checklist of improvements and changes down below.

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new type of items: Medusa's heads. Can be looted after defeating "Medusa shadows". Heads can be sold in the Travellers camp for coins.
[*]Added 6 new achievements
[olist]
[*] Chop-Chop!
[*] Brewmaster
[*] Coinmaster
[*] Only Forward
[*] I See Fire
[*] Like A Jack
[/olist]
[*]New sound effects
[*]Graphics improvements and cosmetic changes.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed "Like A Perseus" achievement bug. To earn this achievement you need to kill a Medusa shadow.
[*] Fixed graphic issues with text.
[*] Small technical improvements.
[/list]

Thank you for your attention and good luck!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33229994/57c67df9f07f5cc3986ee009c1e84c30e9b1ff13.gif[/img]

notes.title: Neverliria Update v1.04
notes.content:
Hello! Neverliria updated to version 1.04. Changes list below.
1) Added description of all buildings in the construction menu.
2) Tutorial bug fixed.
3) Other small issues fixed.
4) Small balance improvements.

notes.title: Neverliria Update v1.03
notes.content:
Hello! Here is another update with few more improvements. 
Changelog:
1) Walls rebalance: 
Now walls cannot be destroyed by shadows, but still, shadow warriors will try to attack them (it works as some kind of distraction). Other shadow types can outflank walls as usually.
2) Added a hint when new enemy types going to appear in order to make it easier to prepare your defense in time.
3) Small bug fixes.
Thank you for your bug reports. Have a nice day!

notes.title: Neverliria quick update v1.02
notes.content:
Changelog:
1) Few more icons added to building panel.
2) Small bug fixes.

notes.title: Neverliria Update v1.01
notes.content:
Greetings! Here is the first update of Neverliria with small improvements in balance/hint system and bug fixes.
Changelog:
1. Small resource rebalance. The terrain was replenished with extra stone.
2. Added hint with resources names in the building panel.
3. Some scripts optimized to avoid rare bugs with items seizing.
4. Other small bug fixes.
Thank you for your feedback and bug reports - it helps us to improve Neverlirira and make gameplay process more smooth.

notes.title: Neverliria is live!
notes.content:
We happy to announce that Neverliria is now available for purchase.
Shadows are coming! Don't forget to hide your chest somewhere in a safe place!
Wish you a good luck and stay with us!

notes.title: Neverliria is coming!
notes.content:
Now it's less than 24 hours until the release of Neverliria. Game production was finished for over two weeks ago, many reviewers and curators have already tried and rated Neverliria. 
And now it is time to show Neverliria to the world.
Another good news is that Neverliria will be available with 10% launch discount for the first week. Hope you will enjoy it!

notes.title: Neverliria - Official Trailer
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33229994/55aeb4c7e878c56e3127908fc7da45c9b5d89bf6.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33229994/4c2510ea15b8c6ed389cae9d4f03c466e8ac1c47.png[/img][/url]

It’s been more than a week since our last publication. The date of the Neverliria release is getting closer every day, so the development of the game is coming to an end. Today we have prepared for you a big pack of new materials. This is the final part of the diary, in which we will share our new developments. Firstly, we are glad to present you our new official trailer.

Check out original article with pack of new materials about the development: http://blog.smarthartgames.com/2018/07/29/neverliria-final-stage-official-trailer/

notes.title: Neverliria - Demo is available via Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33229994/3bd0627e8d8efdfcdd05360698c6c8f81eebc051.gif[/img]Demo version of the game is now available on Steam. 
Live build: v0.2.0. 
Changelog:
-The game was provided with a clock, where you can see the time of dawn, the appearance of the rune and shadows.
-Now the construction menu is available both from the main menu and with the TAB button. The construction menu was redesigned.
-A small rebalance of the resources amount on the terrain.
-Many bugs have been fixed, among the most common: bugs with incorrect construction and a bug of the restart button.
-Other small improvements.
